summary: The root ردف (rdf) primarily means to ride behind someone or something, or to follow closely. It can also describe an event happening unexpectedly or suddenly.
lane: 1 رَدِفَهُ ذ , (T, S, O, Msb, K &c.,) aor. رَدَفَ , (K,) inf. n. رَدْفٌ , (MA, KL,) He rode behind him [ on the same beast ]; (AZ, Sh, Zj, T, MA, Msb;) [and] so رَدَفَهُ , [aor. رَدُفَ ;] (M;) and ; (AZ, Sh, T, M;) said by IAar to signify the same as رَدِفَهُ : (T:) [or, in other words,] رَدِفَهُ signifies he became to him a رِدْف [meaning a رَدِيف ]; and so رَدِفَ لَهُ ; for the Arabs often add the ل with a trans. v. that governs an accus. noun; so that they say, سَمِعَ لَهُ and شَكَرَ لَهُ and نَصَحَ لَهُ , meaning سَمِعَهُ and شَكَرَهُ and نَصَحَهُ : (Fr, T:) [and also] he, or it, followed, or came after, him, or it; (S, O, K, and Ham p. 148;) and so رَدِفَ لَهُ ; (Ham ibid.;) and رَدَفَهُ , aor. رَدُفَ ; (K;) and ; (S, K, and Ham ubi suprà;) and also signifies the same as رَدِفَهُ ; (K;) رَدِفَهُ and being like تَبِعَهُ and أَتْبَعَهُ in [form and] meaning: (S:) [ , likewise, appears to be syn. with رَدِفَهُ ; or, probably, رُدِّفَهُ , which seems to signify lit. he was made to ride behind him; &c.; for it is said that] the inf. n. تَرْدِيفٌ signifies the coming, or going, behind; as also تَرْدَافٌ : (KL:) and رَدِفْتُهُ also signifies I overtook him and outwent him. (Msb: [explained in my copy by لحقته وسبقته : but I think that سبقته is a mistranscription for تَبِعْتُهُ ; and that the meaning therefore is, I overtook him and followed him. ]) One says, كَانَ نَزَلَ بِهِمْ أَمْرٌ فَرَدِفَ لَهُمْ آخَرُ أَعْظَمُ مِنْهُ [ An event had befallen them, and another, of greater magnitude than it, happened afterwards to them ]. (Lth, * T, * S, O.) And أَمْرٌ is a dial. var. of رَدِفَهُ , meaning An event happened to him afterwards: (S, O:) or رَدِفَهُمُ الأَمْرُ and signify the event came upon them suddenly, or unexpectedly; or came upon them so as to overwhelm them. (M.) It is said in the Kur [xxvii. 74], عَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ , meaning [ Perhaps a portion of that which ye desire to hasten ] may have drawn near to you; (Yoo, Fr, T, O,) as though the ل were introduced because the meaning is دَنَا لَكُمْ : or it may mean يَكُونَ رَدِفَكُمْ [may have become close behind you ]; (Fr, T, O;) the ل being introduced for a reason mentioned above, as in سَمِعَ لَهُ &c. for سَمِعَهُ &c.: (Fr, T:) El-Aaraj read رَدَفَ لكم . (O.) And Khuzeymeh Ibn-Málik Ibn-Nahd says, إِذَا الجَوْزَآءُ الثُّرَيَّا ظَنَنْتُ بِآلِ فَاطِمَةَ الظُّنُونَا [ When Orion, or Gemini, shall ride behind, or closely follow, the Pleiades, (an event which will never occur,) I will form in my mind, respecting the family (meaning the father ) of Fátimeh, opinions ]: (S, O:) cited by Fr [and by J] as an ex. of اردفت in the sense of رَدِفَت : (T:) he means Fátimeh the daughter of Yedhkur Ibn-'Anazeh, who [i. e. Yedhkur] was one of the قَارِظَان . (S, O. [Respecting the قارظان , see art. قَرظ .])

headwords.def: (T, S, O, Msb, K &c.,) aor. رَدَفَ, (K,) inf. n. رَدْفٌ, (MA, KL,) He rode behind him [ on the same beast ]; (AZ, Sh, Zj, T, MA, Msb;) [and] so رَدَفَهُ, [aor. رَدُفَ;] (M;) and; (AZ, Sh, T, M;) said by IAar to signify the same as رَدِفَهُ: (T:) [or, in other words,] رَدِفَهُ signifies he became to him a رِدْف [meaning a رَدِيف ]; and so رَدِفَ لَهُ; for the Arabs often add the ل with a trans. v. that governs an accus.
رَدَّفَ see 1, in the former half of the paragraph.

رادفت الدَّابَّةُ The beast allowed a رَدِيف [ to ride it ], and was strong enough to bear him; as also [accord. to some]. (Msb.) You say, هَ ِهِ دَابَّةٌ لَا تُرَادِفُ (T, S, M, O, K) and لَا, (Lth, M, O, K,) but the latter is rare, (K,) or post-classical, of the language of the people of towns and villages, (T, O,) and not allowable, (T,) This beast will not allow a رَدِيف (Lth, T, M) to ride it; (Lth, T;) will not bear a رديف.

(T, S, Msb,) inf. n. إِرْدَافٌ, (Msb,) I made him to ride (Sh, Zj, T, S, Msb) behind me, (Sh, * Zj, T, Msb,) or with me, (S,) on the back of the [ same ] beast; and so: (Msb:) or signifies he placed him behind him on the beast: (M:) and أَرْدَفْتُهُ مَعَهُ I made him to ride with him [or behind him, on the same beast ]. (O, K.) And اردف الشَّىْءَ بِالشَّىْءِ and اردفهُ عَلَيْهِ He made the thing to follow the thing. (M.) See also 1, in six places.

is syn. with تَتَابُعٌ. (T, S, O.) You say, تَرَادَفَا They followed each other. (K.) And ترادف القَوْمُ The people, or party, followed one another: and in like manner one says of anything following another thing. (Msb.) [See also 4.] And ترادف الشَّىْءُ The thing was, or became, consecutive in its parts; one part of the thing followed another. (M.) It is also a word alluding to a certain foul act: (M, O:) from الرِّدْفُ signifying العَجُزُ.

إِرْتَدَفَ see 1, in the former half of the paragraph: and see also 4, in two places. You say also, ارتدفهُ meaning He came behind him; syn. اِسْتَدْبَرَهُ. (S, O.) And ارتدف العَدُوَّ He took the enemy, or seized him, or took him captive, or gained the mastery over him and slew him, coming from behind him; syn. أَخَ َهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ أَخْ ًا. (K.) أَتَيْنَا فُلَانًا فَٱرْتَدَ فْنَاهُ is explained by Ks as meaning أَخَ ْنَاهُ &c. as above [i. e. We came to such a one, and took him, &c.].
He asked him to make him [or to let him ] ride behind him on the back of the beast. (S, * O, Msb, K. *)

: see رَدِيفٌ, in two places. Also A sequent of a thing; (T, S, M, O, Msb, K;) whatever that sequent be: (S, O, Msb, K:) pl. أَرْدَافٌ, which is its pl. in all its senses; (M;) and is particularly applied to the [stars that are] followers of [other] stars; (T, M, O;) [and] its pl.
: see رِدْفٌ, in the former half of the paragraph.
بَهْمٌ رَدْفَى Lambs, or kids, brought forth in the خرِيف [or autumn ], and in the صَيْف [meaning spring ], in the last part of the period in which sheep, or goats, bring forth. (Ibn-'Abbád, O, K.)
The place upon which the رَدِيف, or رِدْف rides. (S, M, O, K.) See also the next paragraph.

One who rides behind another (S, M, O, Msb, K) on the back of the [ same ] beast; (Msb;) as also (S, M, O, Msb, K) and: (S, K:) the pl. (M, K) of the first (M) is رُدَافَى, (M, K, [in my copy of the Msb ردفى, which is app. a mistranscription, and there said to be irreg.,]) or the pl. of رَدِيفٌ is رِدَافٌ, (S, [so in both of my copies,]) and رُدَفَآءُ: (M:) and is used as a sing., syn. with رَدِيفٌ, (T, K,) accord. to some, (T,) as well as pl. [thereof]: (K:) or it is pl.

The function of the رِدْف of a king, (S, O, K,) in the Time of Ignorance: (S: [see رِدْفٌ:]) a term similar to الخِلَافَةُ: (K:) it pertained to the Benoo-Yarbooa, in that time; because there were not among the Arabs any who waged war more than they did against the kings of El- Heereh, who therefore made peace with them on the condition that the ردافة should be assigned to them and that they should abstain from waging war against the people of El-'Irák: (S, O:) it was of two…
: see رَدِيفٌ [of which it is said to be a syn. and also a pl., or pl. of رِدْفٌ, q. v.].

in the Kur lxxix. 7, means The second blast [ of the horn on the day of resurrection ]: (S, O, Bd, Jel, and K in art. رجف:) or the heaven, and the stars, which shall be cleft and scattered. (Bd.) [See also الرَّاجِفَةُ.] See also رِدْفٌ. رَوَادِفُ is pl. of رَادِفَةٌ and of. (K.) It signifies The [ shoots that are termed ] رَوَاكِيب [pl. of رَاكُوبٌ q. v. voce. رَاكِبٌ ] of the palm-tree.
: see the next preceding paragraph.
[ المَرْدُوفُ as opposed to الرَّدِيفُ: see رِدْفٌ.]
مُرَادِفُ لَفْظٍ , in the conventional language of lexicology, A synonym of a word or expression. (Mz, 27th نوع.) [See 3, last signification: and see also مُتَرَادِفُ.]
: see رَدِيفٌ, first sentence.

as a conventional term in lexicology, Synonymous: you say أَلْفَاظٌ مُتَرَادِفَةٌ synonymous words or expressions. (Mz, 27th نوع.) [Loosely explained in the K by the words أَنْ يَكُونَ ٱسْمًا لِشّىْءٍ وَاحِدٍ, meaning significant of one thing; which is the contr. of مُشْتَرَكٌ, i. e. “ homonymous: ” and in like manner, المُتَرَادِفَةُ is expl. in the O, ان تكون أَسْمَآءً لشىءٍ واحدٍ; and is said to be post-classical.] مُتَرَادِفَاتٌ [its pl.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
